_comment: Recommended Claude Code settings inspired by OpenClaw. Copy to .claude/settings.json in your project.

hooks.command: echo '---MEMORY-CONTEXT-START---'; echo '## Long-term Memory'; cat MEMORY.md 2>/dev/null || echo '(no MEMORY.md yet — run /project:memory-promote to create one)'; echo ''; echo '## Today'; cat memory/$(date +%Y-%m-%d).md 2>/dev/null || echo '(no notes today)'; echo ''; echo '## Yesterday'; cat memory/$(date -d yesterday +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null || date -v-1d +%Y-%m-%d 2>/dev/null).md 2>/dev/null || echo '(no notes yesterday)'; echo '---MEMORY-CONTEXT-END---'
